rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides Gmail integration for Claude Code and other MCP clients, enabling email management through the Gmail API with OAuth 2.0 authentication. Supports listing emails from various folders (inbox, sent, unread, starred), reading full email content, sending emails with automatic signature detection, replying to threads with proper threading headers, searching using Gmail's query syntax, and managing labels for starring, archiving, and marking read/unread.
